# The CHOP Full Knowledge Base

The CHOP by Smash Wraps is a 109 mm straight rice-paper tube with capsule-infused flavor in its tip. Flavor stays in the tip instead of being sprayed onto the paper.

## Format
- Three CHOP tubes per retail box
- 1 g and 2 g fill sizes
- Iced Watermelon, Passion Fruit, Pineapple, and Vanilla profiles
- Pinch-activated flavor capsule
- Patent pending
- Adults 21+ where required

## Direct Retail Pricing
- 1 g retail box: $4.75
- 2 g retail box: $5.00

Current product pages control price and availability. Qualified retailers can request wholesale cases at https://smashcones.com/wholesale.
